name: Arbitrary 3D Resolution Discrete Ray Traversal
aliases: Discrete Ray Tracing of Implicit Surfaces
Recursive Octree Traversal with BSP Ordering
definition: A ray tracing method for implicit surfaces that eliminates explicit intersection calculations by voxelizing both the scene (surfaces) and the rays using interval arithmetic within a recursive octree subdivision. It guarantees robustness by traversing rays through a discrete space down to the resolution of floating-point numbers, ensuring the discrete ray matches the continuous ray.
